children.innerHTML: Week of 14 July · written each morning at the market
Everything below is cooked on, over or beside the hearth. The list is short because the fire is honest and the seasons are not negotiable.
as the fire allows, rarely the same twice
roast bones, wild garlic, last night's fire
the day's beast, oak coals, dripping toast
Seven courses, the whole table eats together
The list is one page, mostly growers we have eaten with, leaning on wines that can stand next to smoke. There are exactly four bottles over £100 and none of them need to be.

meta_description: The tasting menu at Ember: seven courses cooked over oak, written each morning at the market.
